subject: Film & Cinema
title: Steven Spielberg: The Blockbuster Artist
description: A quick, practical guide to Steven Spielberg: The Blockbuster Artist.

hook.text: Spielberg invented the blockbuster with Jaws, then proved blockbusters could have a soul.

buildup.text: He oscillates between popcorn spectacle and serious drama — and excels at both.

discovery.text: Schindler's List showed he could channel commercial instincts into profound art.

twist.text: Critics spent decades calling him sentimental before admitting his craft was unmatched.

climax.text: More than any other living director, Spielberg defines what 'a movie' means to most people.

quiz.question: What film proved Spielberg could handle serious dramatic material?
